confidence_model.high: exact route result or multi-character reactive data binding with direct member access
confidence_model.low: reserved; ambiguous same-chunk evidence is not emitted
confidence_model.medium: exact route one-character binding, or item field read in a callback directly rooted at an exact response member

known_limitations: Only response consumers lexically bound to the exact route call are emitted; same-chunk columns and unrelated constants are intentionally ignored.
The extractor proves that frontend code reads a key, not that every successful server response returns it.
Static evidence cannot prove field types, requiredness, privacy classification, or safe external exposure.
Consumers hidden behind stores imported from another chunk, computed keys, generic adapters, or runtime registries can be missed.
A minified one-character binding can be shadowed in a nested scope, so its direct-member evidence is capped at medium confidence.
extractor.strategy: lexical exact-route response binding and direct consumer-chain analysis
